entries.text: أصبت الدنيا والآخرة. قال له: واللات والعزى «ورب هذه البنية «1» » لئن لم تنته عن مقالتك هذه، فإن وجدتك ها هنا، وأنت تعبد غير آلهتنا لأسفعنك على ناصيتك يقول لأخرجنك «2» على وجهك، أليس هؤلاء بناته؟ قال: وأنى يكون له ولد؟ فأنزل الله- عز وجل عَلَّمَ الْإِنْسانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ - 5-
entries.text_ar: أصبت الدنيا والآخرة. قال له: واللات والعزى «ورب هذه البنية «1» » لئن لم تنته عن مقالتك هذه، فإن وجدتك ها هنا، وأنت تعبد غير آلهتنا لأسفعنك على ناصيتك يقول لأخرجنك «2» على وجهك، أليس هؤلاء بناته؟ قال: وأنى يكون له ولد؟ فأنزل الله- عز وجل عَلَّمَ الْإِنْسانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ - 5-
entries.text_en: you will gain the world and the Hereafter. He [Abū Jahl] said to him: By al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā «and the Lord of this edifice (al-bunayya)» [1], if you do not desist from this saying of yours, and I find you here worshipping other than our gods, I will surely seize you by your forelock — he says: I will surely drag you out [2] upon your face. Are not these his daughters? He said: And how could He have a child? So God (Mighty and Majestic) revealed: «Taught man that which he knew not» (5)

2. فى ف زيادة: «فانظر ماذا ترى؟ قال نبى الله- صلى الله عليه وسلم: أما إن الله سيريك آية» ، وليست فى أ. 
3. فى أزيادة: «ثم» ، وليست فى ف. 
4. فى أ، ف: «ثم قال» . 
5. سورة العلق: 15. 
6. سورة العلق: 16. [.....] 
7. فى أ، ف: ( «أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنى، إِنَّ إِلى رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعى» خوفه فى القيامة فى التقديم فقال: «وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ» «لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ لَنَسْفَعاً بِالنَّاصِيَةِ» فى النار، ثم ذكر الناصية فقال: «ناصِيَةٍ كاذِبَةٍ خاطِئَةٍ» أقول وفيه أخطاء ظاهرة وقد حاولت تصحيحه فى أضيق الحدود.
entries.foot_note_en:
1. From A; and in the margin of A: «al-bunayya — with fatḥa on the bāʾ and kasra on the nūn after it, and with a doubled yāʾ — is the Kaʿba, may God ennoble it». And in F: «wa-rabb al-bunayya».
2. In F there is an addition: «so look what you see! The Prophet of God ﷺ said: Indeed, God will show you a sign»; and it is not in A.
3. In A there is an addition: «thumma»; it is not in F.
4. In A, F: «thumma qāla» («then He said»).
5. Sūrat al-ʿAlaq: 15.
6. Sūrat al-ʿAlaq: 16. [.....]
7. In A, F: («that he sees himself self-sufficient, indeed to your Lord is the return» He frightened him with the Resurrection in the taqdīm, so He said: «and your Lord is the Most Generous» «if he does not desist, We will surely seize [him] by the forelock» in the Fire, then He mentioned the forelock, saying: «a lying, sinning forelock»). I say: it contains obvious errors, and I have tried to correct it within the narrowest limits.

entries.text: والنبي- صلى الله عليه وسلم يومئذ بالأراك ضحى «ثم «3» » بين فقال: «خَلَقَ الْإِنْسانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ» يعني من دم حتى تحولت النطفة دما، «اقرأ» يا محمد، ثم استأنف فقال: «وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَ» الكتابة «بِالْقَلَمِ عَلَّمَ الْإِنْسانَ» من القرآن «ما لَمْ يَعْلَمْ» ، ثم قال: كَلَّا لا يعلم إن علمته، ثم استأنف فقال: إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَيَطْغى - 6-

entries.text_en: — and the Prophet ﷺ was on that day at al-Arāk in the forenoon — «then» [3] He clarified, saying: «Created man from a clot (ʿalaq)» — meaning from blood, until the nuṭfa turned into blood; «Read», O Muḥammad; then He began anew, saying: «and your Lord is the Most Generous, Who taught» writing «by the pen, taught man» of the Qur'an «that which he knew not». Then He said: «No!» — he does not know, even if you teach him; then He began anew, saying: «Indeed, man transgresses» (6)

entries.text_ar: في نعم الله- عز وجل يعني أبا جهل بن هشام، وكان إذا أصاب مالا أشر يعني بطر في ثيابه، وفي مراكبه، وفي طعامه وشرابه، فذلك طغيانه، إذا رأى نفسه استغنى، وكان موسرا طغى، فخوفه الله الرجعة إليه فقال: أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنى - 7-
entries.text_en: in the blessings of God (Mighty and Majestic) — meaning Abū Jahl ibn Hishām; and when he gained wealth he became exultant (ashir) — meaning insolent (baṭir) — in his clothing, in his mounts, in his food and drink; that is his transgression: «because he sees himself self-sufficient» — when he saw himself well-off and he was wealthy, he transgressed. So God frightened him with the return to Him, saying: «because he sees himself self-sufficient (7)

surahMaterial.text_en: [Sūrat al-ʿAlaq (96): verses 1 to 19] In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Read in the name of your Lord who created (1) Created man from a clot (ʿalaq) (2) Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous (3) Who taught by the pen (4) Taught man that which he knew not (5) No! Indeed, man transgresses (6) because he sees himself self-sufficient (7) Indeed, to your Lord is the return (8) Have you seen the one who forbids (9) a servant when he prays? (10) Have you seen if he is upon guidance (11) or enjoins righteousness (taqwā)? (12) Have you seen if he denies and turns away? (13) Does he not know that God sees? (14) No! If he does not desist, We will surely seize [him] by the forelock (15) a lying, sinning forelock (16) Then let him call his associates (nādiyah) (17) We will call the guards of Hell (zabāniyah) (18) No! Do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near (19)

1. The main purpose of the sūra: beginning all matters with the name of the Creator, the Lord (Exalted), may His majesty be glorified; the favour upon creation of teaching writing and wisdom; the complaint against the people of misguidance; the threatening of the people of disbelief and disobedience; the frightening of the disbelievers with punishment; and the glad tidings to those who prostrate of nearness, in His saying: «… but prostrate and draw near» (Sūrat al-ʿAlaq: 19).
2. In A: «tisʿata ʿashar»; and the correct is what I established.
3. In the muṣḥaf: (96) Sūrat al-ʿAlaq, Meccan, its verses (19); and it is the first of what was revealed of the Qur'an.

surahMaterial.text: لأنهم كانوا يبدؤون بالسجود، ثم بعد السجود بالركوع، ثم بعد الركوع بالقيام، فكانوا يقومون، ويطلبون المسألة من آلهتهم فأمر الله- تعالى- أن يسجدوا ويقتربوا، فكان رسول الله- صلى الله عليه وسلم يسجد، ثم يركع، ثم يقوم، فيدعو الله- تعالى- ويحمده فخالف الله- تعالى- على المشركين بعد ذلك، فأمر النَّبِيّ- صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يبدأ بالقيام، ثم بالركوع، ثم بالسجود. قال: «فَلْيَدْعُ نادِيَهُ» يعني ناصره «سَنَدْعُ الزَّبانِيَةَ» يعني خزنة جهنم أرجلهم في الأرضين السفلى ورءوسهم فى السماء «كَلَّا لا تُطِعْهُ» يقول للنبي- صلى الله عليه وسلم لا تطع أبا جهل في أن تترك الصلاة، «وَاسْجُدْ» يقول: وصل لله- عز وجل «وَاقْتَرِبْ» إليه بالطاعة، فلما سمع أبو جهل ذكر الزبانية قال قد جاء وعد الله وانصرف عن النبي- صلى الله عليه وسلم، وقد كان هم به، فلما رجع قالوا له: يا أبا الحكم خفته؟ قال: لا، ولكني خفت الزبانية.

surahMaterial.text_en: — because they used to begin with prostration, then after the prostration the bowing, then after the bowing the standing; so they would stand and seek their requests from their gods; so God (Exalted) commanded that they prostrate and draw near; and the Messenger of God ﷺ used to prostrate, then bow, then stand, and then call upon God (Exalted) and praise Him; so God (Exalted) set Himself against the polytheists after that, and commanded the Prophet ﷺ to begin with standing, then bowing, then prostration. He said: «Then let him call his associates» — meaning his supporter — «We will call the guards of Hell» — meaning the keepers of Hell, their feet in the lowest earths and their heads in the heaven — «No! Do not obey him» — He says to the Prophet ﷺ: do not obey Abū Jahl in abandoning prayer — «and prostrate» — He says: and pray to God (Mighty and Majestic) — «and draw near» to Him by obedience. When Abū Jahl heard the mention of the Zabāniyah, he said: The promise of God has come; and he turned away from the Prophet ﷺ, though he had intended [harm] to him. When he returned, they said to him: O Abū l-Ḥakam, were you afraid of him? He said: No, but I feared the Zabāniyah.

1. (1) فى أ: «طيطام» ، وفى ف: «طمطام» . 
2. الحديث النبوي الشريف، من ف، وبه نفس وتصحيف فى أ.
surahMaterial.foot_note_en:
1. In A: «ṭīṭām»; in F: «ṭamṭām».
2. The noble Prophetic ḥadīth is from F; in A it contains [text: «nafs», probably «naqṣ»] omission and misreading (taṣḥīf).
